title: 第2424章 趁机敲一笔第2423章 夏侯徳亲自出面
lines: 夏侯徳这姿态，不能说低，但相较于他平日里的做派，确实是已经很给面子，算是十分的重视。
按说，以夏侯徳的身份，还不至于对林辰如此。
看来，夏侯家现在遇到了麻烦。
这麻烦不是无法突破阴阳庙那么简单。
“前辈言重了，我本事不大，能不能帮上忙还要两说”，林辰道。
夏侯徳笑了笑，“我说了，我相信我夫人的眼光，她不会看错的！”
但愿是吧。
林辰心中腹诽，不过面上则没有继续说什么了，他来这里的确就是赴约，同时也想要趁机夺取造化。
夏侯徳既然不阻止，那林辰也不会退缩。
“其余几位，是一起？”夏侯徳问道。
谢诗莹和白云飞，夏侯徳仅仅扫了一眼，便没有再去关注，毕竟这种小角色实在入不了他的眼。
他只是多看了纪颜几眼。
纪家跟他们夏侯家，可是刚爆发了矛盾不久，纪颜的亲哥纪殊与夏侯厌的大战传遍了神界各区，夏侯家这边可是有着火气。
这纪颜竟然还敢上门来，倒是胆子够大。
“不错”，林辰答道。
来都来了，自然是一起。
“如此，自然再好不过！”夏侯徳道。
如果骆雨棠也插手，的确是一大强援，当然，如此强大的援军最终会不会反而成为他们阻碍，却是不好说了。
虽说骆雨棠的口碑向来不错，但夏侯徳也必须警惕引狼入室。
随即，林辰等人便是随着夏侯徳往阴阳庙而去。
夏侯家的驻地就在附近，但夏侯徳并没有带他们过去休整的意思。
“驻地那边的气机，似乎有些杂乱”，林辰眸光闪了闪。
其中几道气息颇为凌乱，显然不是正常的力量释放所留，恐怕是带着伤，正在修养。
夏侯家强者无数，这次准备更是充分，无上神君甚至都不止两三尊这么简单。
竟然也在阴阳庙折戟不成？
“我夫人如今已经到了阴阳庙深处，但遇到了一些麻烦，还望小友前去相助，若是能够助我夫人脱困，即便没能达成原本的目标，未曾走通这阴阳庙，我夏侯家必有重谢！”夏侯徳道。
说着，已经带着林辰他们来到了阴阳庙的门口。
这座门户，两道门扉一黑一白，有阴阳流转之意，正是阴阳庙的入口。
原本即便只是跨入这阴阳之门，都十分不易，寻常强者进入其中，刹那便会阴阳失衡，直接崩溃。
只不过到了今天，在夏侯家漫长岁月以来的经营之下，阴阳庙前段已经没什么危险可言，可以畅通无阻。
“这是阴阳庙内部的结构图，我夫人他们便在这个位置，小友务必牢记”，夏侯徳交给林辰一张图。
按照图纸来看，此刻的叶蓁的确已经十分深入阴阳庙，距离走通阴阳庙也不远了。
不过看着距离不远，但只怕内部宛如天堑。
“我知道了”，林辰收下图纸，随即则是问道：“前辈是打算就让我们这样进去？”
“夏侯家，不派人吗？”
夏侯徳就这么把他们领到阴阳庙入口了，甚至周边一个夏侯家其他的族人都没有，让林辰有些无语。
这可真够直接的。
“当然不是，我族强者早已经布置在阴阳庙内部，你们进去之后，自然会有我族强者接应，这一点小友尽管放心。”
“可惜我族强者即便都动了，也无法破局，他们都不是关键之人，无法起到关键作用，我希望小友是那关键之人！”夏侯徳道。
林辰没有说什么，转而又是问道：“阴阳庙内是不是出了什么变故，前辈方便透露一些吗？”
content_en:
Xiahou De's attitude cannot be said to be low, but compared to his usual behavior, it is indeed very respectable and can be regarded as a great deal of attention.
Ordinarily, with Xiahou De's status, he would not treat Lin Chen like this.
It seems that the Xiahou family is in trouble now.
This trouble is not as simple as being unable to break through the Yin Yang Temple.
"Senior, you are serious. I am not very capable. I have to wait and see whether I can be of help," Lin Chen said.
Xiahou De smiled, "I said, I believe in my wife's vision, she will not be wrong!"
I hope so.
Lin Chen cursed in his heart, but said nothing more on the surface. He came here just to keep the appointment, and at the same time, he also wanted to take the opportunity to seize the opportunity.
Since Xiahou De didn't stop him, Lin Chen wouldn't back down either.
"Are the rest of them together?" Xiahou De asked.
Xiahou De only glanced at Xie Shiying and Bai Yunfei and stopped paying attention to them. After all, such small characters really couldn't catch his eye.
He just glanced at Ji Yan a few more times.
Not long after the conflict broke out between the Ji family and the Xiahou family, the battle between Ji Yan's brother Ji Shu and Xiahou Yan spread throughout the God Realm, and the Xiahou family was very angry.
This Ji Yan actually dared to come to the door, which was quite courageous.
"Not bad," Lin Chen replied.
We have come, naturally we are together.
"That's the best of course!" Xiahou De said.
If Luo Yutang also intervenes, it will indeed be a big reinforcement. Of course, it is hard to say whether such a powerful reinforcement will eventually become an obstacle to them.
Although Luo Yutang's reputation has always been good, Xiahou De must also be wary of luring wolves into the house.
Immediately, Lin Chen and others followed Xiahou De to Yin Yang Temple.
The Xiahou family's residence was nearby, but Xiahou De had no intention of taking them there to rest.
"The Qi machine over there seems to be a little messy." Lin Chen's eyes flashed.
Several of the auras were quite messy, and were obviously not retained by normal power release. They were probably injured and were recovering.
There are countless powerful people in the Xiahou family, and this time they are even more fully prepared. There are even more than just two or three supreme divine kings.
Even failed in Yin Yang Temple?
"My wife has now reached the depths of the Yin-Yang Temple, but she has encountered some troubles. I hope you can help me. If you can help my wife get out of trouble, even if you fail to achieve your original goal and fail to pass through the Yin-Yang Temple, my Xiahou family will be very grateful!" Xiahou De said.
With that said, he already led Lin Chen and the others to the entrance of Yin Yang Temple.
This portal has two doors, one black and one white, which means the flow of yin and yang. It is the entrance to the Yin and Yang Temple.
Originally, even just stepping into the gate of yin and yang was very difficult. If an ordinary strong person entered it, the yin and yang would be out of balance and collapse in an instant.
But today, under the long-term management of the Xiahou family, there is no danger at all in the front section of the Yin-Yang Temple, and it can be flown unimpeded.
"This is the internal structure diagram of the Yin Yang Temple. My wife and the others are at this location. You must remember this," Xiahou De handed Lin Chen a diagram.
Judging from the drawings, Ye Zhen has indeed gone very deep into the Yin-Yang Temple at this moment, and is not far away from walking through the Yin-Yang Temple.
However, it seems that the distance is not far away, but the inside is like a natural chasm.
"I understand." Lin Chen accepted the drawings and then asked, "Senior, are you planning to let us in like this?"
"Xiahou family, won't you send someone?"
Xiahou De just led them to the entrance of Yin Yang Temple. There was not even a single other Xiahou family member nearby, leaving Lin Chen speechless.
This is pretty straightforward.
"Of course not. The strong men of our clan have already been arranged inside the Yin-Yang Temple. After you enter, there will naturally be strong men of our clan to help you. Don't worry about this, little friend."
"It's a pity that even if the strong men of our clan are moved, they can't break the situation. They are not the key people and cannot play a key role. I hope that my little friend is the key person!" Xiahou De said.
Lin Chen didn't say anything, but then asked: "Did something happen in the Yin-Yang Temple? Could it be convenient for senior to reveal something?"
title_en: Chapter 2424: Taking the opportunity to strike a deal Chapter 2423: Xiahou De came forward in person
